question: Can physically organized two-mode characteristic-polynomial coordinates reduce held-design near-flutter optimism and matched-budget warning misses beyond a matched generic modal-product representation?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 physical clips, existing five design folds, seed42 only, all37 cached measured acquisition conditions; reserved selection/calibration/test and production defaults untouched. No TCN or GRU.
mechanism: For each pair among the three least-stable measured visible modes, divide alpha and angular frequency by the RMS pair natural frequency, form the monic quartic from its two conjugate pole pairs, and append c1,c2,c3,c4,Delta2=c1*c2-c3,Delta3=Delta2*c3-c1*c1*c4,availability. No division by summed damping; no imposed margin sign; no claimed flutter-driving pair identity.
control: Same21 appended columns: pair decay sum/product, natural-frequency-squared sum/product, squared decay difference, squared natural-frequency-squared difference, availability. Same network size/seed/scaling/regularization/training rows.
training: Four unchanged equal-weight acquisition views. MLP32->16, ReLU, native LBFGS, alpha1, tol1e-7, max_iter20000, max_fun400000. Scaling uses proper-fit rows only. Ten new fits: two representations times five folds. Reuse frozen107 and174 predictors exactly; replace only the174-feature member for each50/50 blend. No outer-based tuning or learned fusion.
partition: Reuse contract.split: design-disjoint proper/calibration/held partitions, calibration design shuffle seed947+fold. Fit all four copies together; no calibration or held labels enter fitting or feature construction.
warning: Reuse Gaussian residual score and calibration order-statistic thresholds; nominal stable calibration budgets1%,5%,10%,20%, report actual held stable false warnings. Primary5% budget,1% prespecified secondary. No population-risk certification.
primary: Strict prediction-minus-truth>0.03 on unstable-last1% (-0.01<margin<0), plus near-unstable warning misses at nominal5% stable calibration false-warning budget. Report stable-last1% optimism too. Zero observed event counts do not prove zero risk.
guardrails: Clean/all-condition design MAE, stable/unstable last1%,2%,5% errors and optimism, far-stable underestimation>0.05 for margin>=0.15, actual false warnings at every budget. Assess physical candidate against frozen blend and matched product blend; standalone full arms are diagnostic, not substitutes for blend comparisons.
uncertainty: 2000 fixed-prediction whole-design bootstrap draws preserving acquisition pairs, average fresh views before design resampling. Five-fold TRAIN exploration, one initialization, no refit uncertainty or multiplicity correction; no adoption from a lone improved metric.
verification: Synthetic stable/neutral/unstable poles, scale/swap invariance, missing-pair availability, exact polynomial roots and equivalence of Delta3/c1^2 to the published flutter-margin formula where defined. Actual waveform replay of new coordinates plus stored feature alignment, partition and calibration-budget checks, predictor serialization replay and finite outputs before interpretation.
